lines: Tu meri zindagi hai, tu meri har khushi hai
Tu hi pyaar, tu hi chahat, tu hi bandagi hai
couplets.en: You are my life and every joy, my love, my longing, my devotion.

lines: Tu meri zindagi hai
Jab tak na dekhun tujhe, sooraj na nikle
Jab tak na dekhun tujhe, sooraj na nikle
couplets.en: Until I see you, the sun does not rise.

lines: Zulfon ke saaye saaye mahtaab ubhre
Mere dil ka hosh tu hai, tu hi bekhudi hai
couplets.en: The moon rises in the shadows of your hair, and you are both my heart's awareness and its abandon.

lines: Tu meri zindagi hai, tu meri har khushi hai
Tu hi pyaar, tu hi chahat, tu hi bandagi hai
couplets.en: You are my life and every joy, my love, my longing, my devotion.

lines: Tu meri zindagi hai
Mere labon pe tere naghme milenge
Mere labon pe tere naghme milenge
couplets.en: On my lips you will find songs of you.

lines: Aankhon mein, saathi, tere jalwe milenge
Mere dil mein tu hi tu hai, teri roshni hai
couplets.en: Beloved, in my eyes you will find your radiance, and in my heart only you and your light.

lines: Tu meri zindagi hai
Chhor ke duniya, tujh ko apna bana loon
Chhor ke duniya, tujh ko apna bana loon
couplets.en: Let me leave the world behind and make you mine.

lines: Sab se chhupa ke tujh ko dil mein basa loon
Tu hi meri pehli khwahish, tu hi aakhiri hai
couplets.en: Let me keep you in my heart, hidden from all, my first wish and my last.

lines: Tu meri zindagi hai
